source_en: Closed the flower stall early. Going home to my apartment.
Returning home. Residential block, end of the second row.
Going home to change the water for the lilies.
Going home from the stall. There is nothing left to sell.
Going home to wait. The ceremony is soon, I think.
I live in the building at the end of the street. That is all.
Going home for the lockdown period. As instructed.
Going home. I stood at the stall for a while. It is gone now.
Returning to my registered residence. I have my papers.
I am going to meet my florist. She has my bouquet ready.
First visit to the city. Staying with a cousin for a week.
Buying flowers for my mother. I never know which kind to pick.
Going to buy a dress for the ceremony. I have nothing to wear.
Taking supper home to my husband and the children.
Delivering fresh roses to my stall. Business is very good.
Going to return the wedding dress. I never liked it.
Going to my anniversary dinner. Ten years married today.
Visiting. I live in Varka. I have no address in this city.
Here. My documents. Could we be quick? I have somewhere to be.
Good morning. I keep my papers in the flowers. I forgot, I do not have flowers today.
I am a resident. I have been a resident for four years. The dress is for later.
My documents. Here. The dress is for a fitting. They asked me to wear it in.
I know how this works. I come through every day. You can check your list.
Here. Thank you. I am going home. I am not sure when the ceremony is. Soon, I think.
I have my papers. I have always had my papers. The dress is for the wedding. It is soon.
I know you. You have been here before. We have met. You waved at me once.
I do not need much time. I know the questions. I will answer the ones I can.
Thank you. You are very kind. There is a ceremony later. You should come.
Thank you. I will remember your face. I remember every face.
Good. Good. I knew you would understand. Not everyone does.
Oh. All right. Could someone call, no, never mind. I will wait. I am good at waiting.
I do not understand. I have my papers. I always have my papers. I have my papers.
Please. I have somewhere to be. Please. It will not take long.
But the… I was supposed to… the flowers are…
I only needed to get home. That is all. I only needed to get home.
Oh… I see… that is… that is all right then… it is fine…
I am not sick. I am just wearing a dress. People wear dresses.
Could someone water my plants? I have plants at home. They need water every second day.
Is there a window? I would like to see outside. I like to see if it is raining.
I thought… I was sure there was still time…
I did not understand. I had my papers. I had everything right.
Is the ceremony… will someone tell them I… tell them I tried to…
Where are you coming from?
The flower stall on the residential row. Funerals, mostly. Lilies. I closed early to come home.
The stall. There are no flowers left to sell. I arranged the empty buckets. Then I walked home.
The stall. Or where it used to be. I stood there for a while. Then I came here.
The bakery on Lenina Street. I work the ovens there. Six years now.
My new flat. I only moved to the residential block last week. I am still unpacking.
From home. My husband walked me to the corner. We have been married for many years.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
No. I remember procedures very well. Other things I lose sometimes. That is not a symptom.
I lose small things. Keys. Days. I do not sleep much. I wait up. I feel fine.
I am a little tired. I have been waiting a long time. That is all it is.
No. My memory is perfect. I have never lost anything in my life. Not one thing.
Only a stiff neck from the dress. I bought it on Monday. I had never worn it before this week.
Nothing. I am not waiting for anything. There is no wedding. There never was.
I know you are not supposed to ask about the dress. Most people do not ask.
There is a ceremony soon. I am told to stay ready. So I stay ready.
I have been through this checkpoint many times. You get used to the smell.
The dress holds its shape well. Considering. I have had it a long time.
I once asked someone here what day it was. He told me. It was not the day I thought it was.
I do not mind waiting. I have been waiting for quite a while now. A little longer is nothing.
Do you think it will rain? I cannot get the dress very wet. I have already had it cleaned once.
Everyone always looks at the dress first. I understand. It is a very white dress.
I have been counting the days. I stopped when I lost count. It was a high number.
